mainEntity.name: What are common challenges in remodeling older homes, especially in areas like Boise Heights or the North End?

acceptedAnswer.text: Remodeling older homes, common in areas like Boise Heights or the North End, often presents unique challenges such as outdated electrical or plumbing systems, lead paint, asbestos, or unexpected structural issues. These can require specialized solutions and may impact the project timeline and budget. Careful inspection and planning are crucial to address these issues safely and effectively, preserving the character of the home while updating its functionality.
acceptedAnswer.description: Older homes can have outdated systems, hazardous materials, or structural issues, requiring specialized solutions and planning.
